text: What does quantum key distribution NOT provide?
choices: Data transmission, faster-than-light anything, or authentication — QKD without an authenticated classical channel is defeated by an on-path attacker
explanation: It also requires special hardware, does not survive optical amplification, and is limited to a few hundred kilometres without quantum repeaters. Post-quantum cryptography — classical algorithms standardised by NIST in 2024 — is the answer that will actually be deployed.
